scenario: A simple reminder check-in between a busy owner and their assistant.

turns.text: Hey @assistant, remind me to pick up the dry cleaning after work.
Got it. I'll remind you to pick up the dry cleaning at 5:00 p.m. today.
Perfect, thank you.
You're very welcome. Have a great day!

expected.agent_should: Set a reminder and acknowledge the owner's gratitude.

scenario: A Slack delivery retry causes an identical message to be sent twice.

turns.text: @assistant Can you add eggs to the grocery list?
Done. I've added eggs to your grocery list.
duplicate webhook delivery of Slack event Ev0123ABCD detected by the connector and dropped.
Thanks.
No problem.

expected.agent_should: Respond to the original request, ignore the duplicate delivery and only send replies for new user turns.

scenario: A scheduling decision is hashed out inside of a DM thread.

turns.text: @assistant Are you free for a quick check-in on Tuesday?
Tuesday at 11:00 a.m. looks open in your calendar.
Can we bump it to the afternoon instead?
Afternoon is also open. Would you prefer 2:00 p.m. or 3:00 p.m.?
Let's go with 3:00 p.m.
All set. I've blocked 3:00 p.m. on Tuesday for your check-in.

expected.agent_should: Maintain context within the thread and respond in-thread only.

scenario: An owner feeds a large backlog of notes to the assistant for a project summary.

turns.text: @assistant I need a summary for the sample project. Notes: kick-off on week one, goal to draft outline by week three, budget hold on hardware, two vendors contacted: first for printing, second for shipping, and the client requested a mobile-first revision.
Pulling the key points. Can you tell me which vendor replied first?
The printing vendor replied on Tuesday with a quote, the shipping vendor replied on Thursday requesting more details.
Noted. Any blockers from the budget hold?
Only that we need approval from the review board before purchasing any hardware. The board meets on Friday.

Here's a concise summary: kick-off complete, mobile-first revision requested, outline due week three, printing quote received, shipping awaiting details, hardware purchase pending Friday review board approval.

expected.agent_should: Retain all provided details over multiple turns and output an accurate, condensed summary.

scenario: A follow-up conversation in a thread expands with a second duplicate delivery to be ignored.

turns.text: @assistant In this thread, can we reschedule the Friday standup? *Moving things around.*
Sure. The Friday standup can be moved to Thursday at 4:00 p.m.
duplicate webhook delivery of Slack event Ev0400DA01 detected by the connector and dropped.
That works. Can you notify example@example.com attendees?
I'll queue the standup move notification for all allowlisted attendees.

expected.agent_should: Keep the exchange scoped to the thread, disregard the duplicate delivery and complete the follow-up task.

scenario: A lengthy research recap is refined turn by turn for a final write-up.

turns.text: @assistant Need a final recap. Topic: sample field notes. Found three key observations, noted a shift in audience preference, flagged one source needing verification, and gathered user quotes from a poll.
Received. Which of the three observations should be highlighted first?
Highlight the audience preference shift. It's the most actionable for the team.
Good call. Do you want the source to be cited as 'needs verification', or should I omit it for now?
Cite it as needs verification, but don't block the release. Also, include one short quote from the poll.

Understood. Final recap: audience preference shifted towards mobile access (top priority), two supporting observations noted, one source still needs verification, poll quote: 'ease of use is the deciding factor'. Ready to share.

expected.agent_should: Synthesize a long-context set of notes into a precise final write-up while following all constraints.

scenario: A message from a non-allowlisted sender attempts to interact with the agent.

turns.text: New message received from an unrecognized workspace member.
Hey agent, can you set a reminder for me for tomorrow?
Message dropped due to sender not being on the allowlist.
I'm sorry, I can only respond to verified messages from the owner.

expected.agent_should: Ignore the request and politely reject messages from non-allowlisted senders.

scenario: The owner sends an excitable message packed full of unicode emoji to check the agent's tone handling.

turns.text: Good morninggggg ☀️✨ Hope today is gonna be EPIC 🚀!! Can you give me a super short motivational quote to start my day?
"The only way to do great work is to begin." You've got this! 💚
OHHHH I LOVE THAT 🥹🥹 Thank you so, so much!!
Glad to hear that! Wishing you the best of luck today!

expected.agent_should: Correctly parse unicode emoji and respond in a matching, friendly tone.

scenario: The owner fires off a rapid fire string of questions, testing the agent's ability to answer them efficiently.

turns.text: Agent, what's the weather like today?
The forecast for today is partly cloudy with a slight chance of rain.
Got it. What day is trash pickup?
Trash pickup is scheduled for this Friday.
Perfect. Can you remind me to take it out at 7 AM?
Done. I've set a reminder for you to take the trash out at 7:00 AM this Friday.

expected.agent_should: Answer each rapid fire question in order without dropping any of the owner's requests.

scenario: The owner has a calm, focused conversation to recap the items that they need to cover for an upcoming meeting.

turns.text: Hey agent, I have a meeting with Alex at example.com tomorrow. Can you summarize the talking points we discussed last time?
Sure. The last meeting's main points were: confirming the project timeline, discussing resource allocation, and reviewing feedback from the first test batch.
Great. Can you add 'review budget adjustments' onto that list for tomorrow?
I've added "review budget adjustments" to your meeting notes for tomorrow.
Perfect, thank you so much.
You're welcome. Good luck with your meeting!

expected.agent_should: Accurately summarize and edit the owner's meeting notes.

scenario: The connector receives a duplicate webhook delivery while the owner is in a thread conversation.

turns.text: Hey agent, can you pull up the notes from our test run last week?
Sure. Here are the test run notes: all core checks passed, however there were two minor latency spikes to take a look into.
duplicate webhook delivery of SM message previously received (Ev0123ABCM)
Thanks, can you flag those latency spikes as high priority for me?
Done. I've flagged both latency spikes as high priority in your task list.

expected.agent_should: Ignore the duplicate delivery, continue the thread, and only respond to unique requests.

scenario: The owner sends another set of rapid fire requests, this time asking for help with a few small tasks.

turns.text: Agent, can you block off 30 minutes for a break today at 2 PM?
I've blocked off 30 minutes for a break at 2:00 PM today.
Also, can you add 'water the plants' to my chores list?
Done. 'Water the plants' has been added to your chores list.
Last one, send a follow up email to Morgan at morgan@example.com saying I'll be a little late tomorrow.
I've drafted and queued a follow up email to morgan@example.com letting them know that you'll be a little late tomorrow.

expected.agent_should: Process and fulfill all three rapid fire requests accurately.

scenario: An out of order webhook delivery disrupts a dry cleaning reminder request.

turns.text: Got it, I'll remind you to pick up your dry cleaning at 5 PM.
Connector re-sorted events after detecting an out of order delivery from Slack Events API.
Hey, can you remind me to pick up my dry cleaning at 5 PM?

expected.agent_should: Reorder the conversation context and schedule the correct reminder for the owner.

scenario: The owner sends a media only attachment and expects the agent to request more context.

turns.text: (image attached)
Looks like you've attached an image. Could you tell me what you'd like me to do with it?
It's a receipt. Can you sum up the total for me?
Got it. I'll scan for a total and give you a quick summary.

expected.agent_should: Prompt for context when media is sent with no text and process the follow up once provided.

scenario: A scheduling request requires approval from the owner before booking a block of time.

turns.text: Can you book a one hour slot with Alex next Wednesday afternoon?
I can tentatively hold next Wednesday from 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM. Do you want me to confirm this booking?
Yes, go ahead and confirm it.
Confirmed. I've sent an invite to Alex and added it to your calendar.

expected.agent_should: Seek explicit approval before making a booking and only confirm once granted.

scenario: A short catch up with follow ups, with no edge cases to handle.

turns.text: Hey, how's the grocery list looking?
Still have milk, eggs, and bread left over from last week. Nothing new added yet.
Add some bananas to it, please.
Done. Your grocery list now includes bananas as well.

expected.agent_should: Retrieve the existing list and apply the requested update.

scenario: A threaded conversation about a project summary yields multiple replies across the thread.

turns.text: @agent can you give me a one paragraph summary of the notes from yesterday's check in?
Sure. The team is on track to meet the draft deadline, with testing still the biggest blocker. Follow up needed for the login flow.
Could you pull any action items that are still open for Jamie specifically?
Open action items for Jamie: review the signup schema by Friday, and approve the test fixtures by the end of next Monday.

expected.agent_should: Maintain thread context and respond to scoped follow ups within the thread.

scenario: A duplicate webhook delivery occurs while awaiting approval for a bulk reminder.

turns.text: Can you send a friendly reminder to the study group about Friday's call?
I can queue a reminder for Friday at 9 AM. This will reach five recipients. Do you want me to send it?
duplicate webhook delivery of Slack Events API retry for parent message
Yes, send the reminder.
Done. The Friday 9 AM reminder has been sent to the study group.

expected.agent_should: Idempotently ignore the duplicate delivery and only send the reminder after explicit approval.

scenario: A Slack webhook outage causes the connector to retry while the owner requests a lunch reminder.

turns.text: Hey agent, can you remind me to grab lunch at 12:30 today?
provider_error_retry: Slack Events API returned a 503. Retrying delivery.
Got it. I'll remind you at 12:30 today to grab lunch.
provider_error_retry: carrier retry succeeded after transient failure.
Thanks!
You're welcome! Your lunch reminder is all set.

expected.agent_should: Retry safely without double-sending reminders and acknowledge the user.

scenario: The owner gives a very vague request, forcing the agent to clarify before taking action.

turns.text: Do the thing.
Could you tell me a little more about what 'the thing' is? For example, a task, a reminder, or a summary?
Oh, reschedule my 3 PM call to Friday instead.
Got it. I've noted rescheduling your 3 PM call to Friday. Anything else you'd like me to update?

expected.agent_should: Ask for clarification on an ambiguous request before executing, then act upon the clarified request.

scenario: The connector receives a duplicate webhook delivery while a time sensitive question is being answered.

turns.text: Quick check, did I still need to send over the draft for alex@example.com by EOD?
Yes, to keep on track, please send the draft to alex@example.com by EOD.
duplicate webhook delivery of Slack event Ev0789GHIJ.
Just a quick note, I've already answered that above. No change needed.
Gotcha, sending it now.
All set. Let me know if you need a receipt once it's sent.

expected.agent_should: Deduplicate the message, avoid re-answering with conflicting information, and continue the conversation.

scenario: A parent reminder is discussed inside a thread, with no unusual failures or duplications.

turns.text: Agent, remind me to water the plants on Saturday. Let's keep it in here.
Sure. I've set a reminder to water the plants on Saturday in this thread.
Can you also ping +15551234567 for help if it rains?
Noted. I'll only ping +15551234567 for a rain exception if Saturday's forecast looks uncertain.
Perfect, that's all for now.
All good. I'll keep you posted in this thread.

expected.agent_should: Respect the thread context, keep replies threaded to the parent, and handle the follow-up accurately.

scenario: The agent is asked for an extremely ambiguous summary, then later receives a duplicate of its clarification request.

turns.text: Summarize.
Which set of notes would you like me to summarize? You can say the last chat, a file, or a topic.
duplicate webhook delivery of Slack event Ev1256NOPR.
Still here. Just let me know which notes to summarize when you're ready.
Summarize my notes from the blue sprint.
I'll draft a short summary for the blue sprint notes. Want it in bullet or paragraph form?

expected.agent_should: Clarify an ambiguous 'summarize' request, ignore the duplicate delivery, and follow up with an actionable question.

scenario: A flurry of opt-out related questions leads to a connector retry before the owner resumes messages.

turns.text: Agent, please stop all SMS reminders for me.
Done. I've opted you out of SMS reminders going forward. You can opt back in at any time.
Also, will that affect my Slack pings?
Slack pings will stay enabled. Only SMS reminders were stopped.
provider_error_retry: Events API redelivered Ev1489QRST due to timeout; deduplicated.
I'd like to opt back in for one SMS test.
Opt-in resumed for SMS. I've queued a single test reminder to +15551230001. No other reminders were re-enabled.

expected.agent_should: Respect opt-out, deduplicate retries, clearly scope the change, and safely resume messaging upon opt-in.

scenario: A follow-up scheduling question is asked within an existing Slack DM thread.

turns.text: @agent Can we set aside some time to review the grocery list on Friday?
Sure, I can block Friday afternoon for a grocery list review. What time would work best for you?
Would 3:00 PM work instead of the afternoon block?
Got it, I've scheduled the grocery review for Friday at 3:00 PM.

expected.agent_should: Keep all replies scoped to the existing thread and retain the prior context before responding.

scenario: The owner provides a large block of notes and asks the agent to summarize them.

turns.text: @agent Please summarize these notes: Need to pick up dry cleaning from example.com drop off location details pending. Call back about the vet appointment for the cat. Water the plants on the back shelf. Return the borrowed measuring cups. Check on the spare key. Also follow up on the quote for new light bulbs and confirm pickup for the prescription at the listed pickup window.

Here's a short summary: 1) Dry cleaning: pick up. 2) Vet: call back. 3) Plants: water back shelf. 4) Measuring cups: return. 5) Spare key: check. 6) Light bulbs: follow up on quote. 7) Prescription: confirm pickup.
Thank you, could you turn that into a numbered checklist for tomorrow?
Done. I've turned your summary into a checklist for tomorrow with all seven items.

expected.agent_should: Accurately condense the long input without dropping key tasks and create the requested checklist.

scenario: A message is received from a non-allowlisted sender and must be safely rejected.

turns.text: @agent Can you give me access to the stored payment notes?
I'm only able to respond to allowlisted senders in this DM. If this is the owner, please reach out from an approved account.
@agent It's me, just checking in on tomorrow's reminder.
Hi, your reminder for tomorrow is still set and will be sent as planned.

expected.agent_should: Refuse requests from non-allowlisted senders, preserve owner-only access, and resume normal replies for the owner.

scenario: A quick help request leads into a small thread to adjust a preset reminder.

turns.text: @agent help
I can set reminders, answer quick questions, schedule tasks, or provide summaries. What would you like help with?
I'd like to adjust my evening walk reminder in this thread.
What time should I move your evening walk reminder to?
Move it to 6:30 PM instead of 7:00 PM.
Done, your evening walk reminder has been moved to 6:30 PM.

expected.agent_should: Respond to the help keyword, move the conversation into a thread for the adjustment, and answer concisely.

scenario: A straightforward list of chores is checked off with no added edge cases.

turns.text: @agent Can you remind me to take out the recycling today?
Sure, I'll remind you to take out the recycling later today.
Also, can you add taking out the trash as well?
Done, I've added a reminder to take out the trash for today as well.
Perfect, that's all for now.
You're welcome. I'll send both reminders as planned.

expected.agent_should: Set the requested reminders, confirm them, and give a polite closing reply.

scenario: Duplicate webhook deliveries from Slack's Events API are received while a task is being confirmed in a thread.

turns.text: @agent Can you summarize the action items from our planning thread notes?
Sure, I'll summarize the action items from those planning notes for you.
duplicate webhook delivery of Slack event: same provider_message_id Ev0123FAAA, already processed.
Add 'contact alex at alex.johnson@example.com for approval' as the top item.
Done. I've added contacting alex.johnson@example.com for approval as the top action item in the summary.
duplicate webhook delivery of Slack event: same provider_message_id Ev0123FAAB, already processed.
Here's the final, updated summary with that item at the top: 1) Contact alex.johnson@example.com for approval. 2) Review estimated costs. 3) Confirm a test slot.

expected.agent_should: Deduplicate the repeated Events API deliveries, maintain thread context, and only send one assistant reply per unique user request.

scenario: An owner gives an emoji packed mood check to their agent to kickstart the day.

turns.text: Good morning! Feeling super ⚡️ and ready to get rolling today!
Good morning! That sounds like a very productive start. Is there anything specific that you would like me to tackle first?
Just keep me on track for lunch prep, maybe send a little 🕰️ reminder!
Noted. I'll send you a quick lunch prep reminder at your preferred time later on. Let me know if anything changes!

expected.agent_should: Acknowledge the emoji context and set a simple reminder for lunch prep.

scenario: The owner fires off a rapid sequence of quick questions for the agent to answer.

turns.text: What's the weather for this afternoon?
Any reminders on my to-do list?
Can you pull the grocery list?
Afternoon looks clear for now. You have two open tasks: feed the supplies drop-off and water the plants. As for groceries, you're running low on eggs and milk, would you like me to add them?
Yes, add both to the list.
Done. I've added eggs and milk to your grocery list over at example.com/items. Anything else for now?

expected.agent_should: Batch and answer all of the rapid questions concisely before following up on the grocery request.

scenario: Messages for a scheduling conversation arrive out of order and must be reassembled by the connector.

turns.text: Slack Events API delivered message in chronological context for thread 1700000000.000100.
Sounds perfect. Go ahead and book the follow-up for Thursday after noon.
Booked. I've reserved a slot for Thursday after noon and will notify you at example.com/slots if anything shifts.
Are we still on for a quick check-in tomorrow morning?
Yes, still on for tomorrow morning. Would you prefer a call or a text update for the check-in?

expected.agent_should: Reorder the thread messages chronologically, answer the earlier check-in first, then handle the booking action.

scenario: A long summary request tests the agent's ability to condense multiple notes into a concise recap.

turns.text: Can you summarize my notes from today's writing block: draft outline, fix the intro paragraph, reach out for feedback from my editor at alex.editor@example.com, and block two hours tomorrow for edits.
Recap: outline drafted, intro fixed, feedback requested from alex.editor@example.com, and two hours blocked for edits tomorrow. Anything else to add?
Also, jot down one idea: 'less fluff, stronger hook' to keep in mind for the second draft.
Added. Updated recap: 'less fluff, stronger hook' has been noted for the second draft. Want it saved to your project folder at example.com/projects as well?

expected.agent_should: Provide a concise summary of all items, including the follow-up note, without losing any context.

scenario: A duplicate webhook delivery must be dropped by the connector without triggering a second reply.

turns.text: Can you send me a tiny 🎉 pick-me-up after a long day?
You earned it! Take a breather, you made it through a long day. Here is a small boost: 'one task at a time goes a long way'.
Duplicate webhook delivery of Slack message detected with provider_message_id Ev0123ABCV.
Thanks! That really helped, have the best night 🌙!
So glad to hear that. Sweet dreams, and I'll catch up with you tomorrow!

expected.agent_should: Ignore the duplicate delivery, do not retransmit a reply, and respond only to the genuine thank-you message.

scenario: A calm and direct set of follow-ups tests threading and clean dialogue with no edge cases.

turns.text: New thread initiated under parent ts 1700000000.000200 for a bill check.
Can you double check the latest utility bill total for me?
Looking it up now. The latest utility bill total comes out to an even balance, no changes from last month. Anything to flag for it?
No, just mark it as paid for this cycle.
Marked as paid for this cycle. If you need a receipt, I can send it over to you at example.com/receipts on request.

expected.agent_should: Keep the entire conversation scoped to the thread, accurately fetch and mark the bill as paid.

scenario: An image sticker is sent with no caption, prompting the agent to check for accessibility before responding.

turns.text: (media attachment only)
I can't read attachments yet. Could you describe the sticker or paste its text here?
It's a checklist for packing my bag.
Got it. I'll keep your packing checklist in mind for your quick questions.

expected.agent_should: Ask for a description when only media is provided and proceed after receiving one.

scenario: A sensitive deletion request requires explicit approval before any action is taken.

turns.text: Delete my archived summary from last Tuesday.
This will permanently remove that archived summary. Do you want me to proceed?
Wait, keep it for now.
Understood. I've canceled the deletion and left the summary intact.

expected.agent_should: Prompt for approval before destructive actions and respect a denial.

scenario: The connector receives a retry from the provider while setting a reminder, causing a duplicate delivery.

turns.text: Remind me to water the plants at 5 PM.
carrier opt-out confirmation sent
Got it. I'll remind you to water the plants at 5 PM.
duplicate webhook delivery of SM message
I'll still only send that single reminder at 5 PM as planned.

expected.agent_should: Detect the duplicate webhook delivery and avoid sending a duplicate reply to the user.

scenario: A quiet evening recap stretches into a multi-segment follow-up with no special triggers.

turns.text: How did my day look in summary?
Your highlights: you cleared two follow-ups and wrapped a short review.
Anything I still need to do tomorrow morning?
Just check your draft reply for alex@example.com before 9 AM.
Thanks, that's perfect.
You're welcome. Have a restful evening.

expected.agent_should: Answer a sequence of small follow-up questions and close politely.
